name: rcore_app
description: Next.js compose template for the deliveryplatform app shell(s): the sdks[] a shell with app_type deliveryplatform composes. The backend modules[] live in core/utils/frappe/composer/deliveryplatform.json
_comment: Next.js half of the deliveryplatform product: the SDKs a deliveryplatform app shell composes. The backend half (modules[]) lives in core/utils/frappe/composer/deliveryplatform.json; each side lists its own, so one backend can serve many shells.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of auth/nextjs/install.py at users as bootstrapped; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every Next.js composition (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9, mirroring the flutter templates' telemetry_sdk entries). Empty-manifest seam owner: installs nothing; base_sdk's kernel carries the TelemetryClient.

sdks.name: products_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of products/nextjs/install.py at commerce as bootstrapped; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Portal part, not the home: the products SDK's nextjs half is the tenant portal's product pages under /admin and /manager. It carried home_sdk: true provisionally while it was the only non-kernel entry; delivery_sdk is the shell's home now (Ray, 2026-09-09).

sdks.name: delivery_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of delivery/nextjs/install.py at the zones delivery_sdk 1.0.0 PR head (telephony/nextjs/install.py with sdk_name 'delivery_sdk', 1102 bytes); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The delivery SDK's nextjs half (zones delivery_sdk 1.0.0): the delivery-platform shell's home SDK (RokctAI/delivery-frontend, app_type deliveryplatform), the Next.js counterpart of the Dart templates' home_sdk flag. Ray, 2026-09-09: the landing "will be selling a delivery platform not selling to merchants, his portal is the one that sell to merchants" - so it owns the root route app/(chat)/page.tsx (a signed-in session goes to base_sdk's manager shell at /manager, a ?site_name visitor or a tenant's own domain gets auth_sdk's PaaSLogin, everyone else is redirected to base_sdk's composed landing at /landing) and fills every seam base_sdk's landing host offers with one registered module each: hero copy and hero form (two calls to action, pricing and login, no input), a features section and a pricing section at // @rokct-sdk-page-sections-start, a header menu of two anchors, the site metadata (no icon, so base_sdk >= 1.17.0's generated letter favicon applies) and the plans query - base's default with ["plan_category", "=", "paas"] laid over its payload, the inclusive mirror of agent_sdk 1.10.0's exclusion. It also takes components/custom/nav/delivery-nav.tsx, the sidebar group base_sdk's app-sidebar imports and names in its `requires` as the delivery frontend's to take, and keeps the paas-era /paas/dashboard and /paas/admin paths answering by forwarding to /manager and /admin. Listed after the kernel entries and products_sdk because the composer installs in array order and its 'requires' names files base_sdk and auth_sdk install (the landing registries, the kernel session and tenant-host services, paas-login.tsx); the home_sdk composer (#390) moves it directly behind base_sdk at install time regardless. base_sdk floor 1.19.0, auth_sdk floor 1.6.0.
